tool_input.code:
import requests
base='https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/'
terms=['"Equisetum arvense" AND (macrophage OR monocyte OR neutrophil OR leukocyte OR lymphocyte)','"Equisetum arvense" AND inflammation AND cells','Equisetum arvense immunomodulatory']
for term in terms:
 r=requests.get(base+'esearch.fcgi',params={'db':'pubmed','term':term,'retmax':20,'retmode':'json'},timeout=20)
 print('\nQUERY',term,'STATUS',r.status_code)
 ids=r.json().get('esearchresult',{}).get('idlist',[])
 print('PMIDS',ids)
 if ids:
  s=requests.get(base+'esummary.fcgi',params={'db':'pubmed','id':','.join(ids),'retmode':'json'},timeout=20).json()['result']
  for i in ids: print(i,s[i].get('pubdate'),s[i].get('title'))

entities.name: Equisetum arvense
observations: Common horsetail extract was investigated for direct immunomodulatory effects on human lymphocytes in vitro.

entities.name: PMID:25088216
observations: 2014 study reported dose-dependent inhibition of activated human T-lymphocyte proliferation by standardized Equisetum arvense extract, with lower activation markers and intracellular IL-2; no apoptosis/necrosis was detected.

source_tools.relevance: Primary paper citation verified by PubMed query; experimental summary from literature search
